name: echo bot - LINE Messaging API
description: This is a sample application for the LINE Messaging API

LINE_CHANNEL_ID.description: LINE channel ID (Basic settings page), used to verify LIFF idToken

LIFF_ID.description: LIFF app ID for the sales upload form (e.g. 1234567890-AbCdEfGh)

GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.description: Google service account credentials JSON (as a single-line string), used to write to Google Sheets

GOOGLE_SHEET_ID.description: ID of the Google Sheet (from its URL) that stores sales records

MANAGER_USER_IDS.description: Comma-separated LINE user IDs allowed to query/track records

SALES_USERS.description: JSON object mapping LINE user ID to sales person display name, e.g. {"U123...": "王小明"}

SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP server host used to email the manager when a new sales record is submitted

FROM_EMAIL.description: Sender email address for notifications (defaults to SMTP_USERNAME)

MANAGER_EMAIL.description: Comma-separated email addresses to notify when a new sales record is submitted
